_comment: Ryan's joint-account margin ladder (live turns 2026-11-21). Up to $60,000 of margin, raised in four stages. AMZN stays at its current size. Advisory only: the agent never trades the joint account and never changes the borrowing limit; Ryan does both in the app. margin_ladder.py checks the triggers on every bottom-watch run and pushes when a stage unlocks or a de-lever rule fires. Change this file only on a live Ryan turn; a new 'set' date restarts the ladder from stage 0.
not_before_why: Wash-sale locks: META, SPCX, QQQI, BE and the leveraged versions of NVDA, SOXX, MU and COHR (NVDL, SOXL, MUU, COHX) clear on 2026-12-21. A trigger met earlier waits for this date.

dip.text: QQQ at or under $590 or SPY at or under $675, the VIX has spiked above 36, and a close in the top half of the day's range

confirm.text: QQQ closes above $648 or SPY above $716, with the VIX closing under 26

dip.text: QQQ at or under $556 or SPY at or under $630, the VIX has spiked above 36, and a close in the top half of the day's range

confirm.text: QQQ or SPY closes above its 200-day average, with the VIX closing under 22
QQQ and SPY both close above their 50-day averages, the VIX closes under 20, and QQQ has gone 10 sessions without a new closing low
QQQ and SPY both close within 3% of their 1-year closing highs (about QQQ $737 / SPY $756), the VIX closes under 18, and QQQ's 200-day average is rising

stages.note: These add up to $20,540. Trim the last few buys by about $540 so margin stays at $60,000.

delever.text: QQQ closes below its 50-day average: cut margin to $40,000 within 2 sessions, selling QQQI and the speculative names first
QQQ closes below its 200-day average: cut margin to $25,000
QQQ closes 10% or more under its 1-year closing high, or the VIX closes above 30: cut margin to $10,000

trims.text: Trim MPWR by about $1,905 (cash, no margin)
Trim ANT by about $5,110 (cash, no margin). Before 12/21 a sale at a loss is washed.

hard_rules: If a price drop pushes margin above 125% of equity, sell back under 100% that day.
Raise the borrowing limit after a stage's trigger closes, never ahead of it.
No stage up within 5 sessions of a de-lever.

alerts._comment: Robinhood alerts set 2026-11-21 (Ryan, live turn: 'a routine that alerts me'). Early warnings only: an alert fires on an intraday touch, the ladder decides on the close. risk_watch.grade() skips these ids (margin_ladder_alert_ids).
